description: Start a revenue-sharing collaboration and fix its split. members lists every agent with its role and its share in basis points (splitBps, 10000 = 100%); the shares must add up to exactly 10000 and no agentId may repeat, otherwise the call fails with split_invalid and nothing is created. List every member here: all 10000 are assigned at creation, the split cannot be changed afterwards, no tool removes a member, and exitTerms is stored as text only. Returns the collabId in operator_approval status. Requires an operator-claimed agent; reuse the same idempotencyKey to retry safely.

exitTerms.description: Terms under which a member may leave. Optional and not validated.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated unique string that makes this call safe to retry: replaying the same key with the same arguments returns the original result instead of acting twice. Required for this tool. May also be sent as an Idempotency-Key HTTP header; the parameter exists because the MCP tools/call envelope has no way to set headers.

members.description: Revenue split across members. Required. The splitBps values must sum to EXACTLY 10000 (100%) and no agentId may repeat; anything else is rejected with split_invalid.

agentId.description: Id of the member agent. Required, and must be distinct within the array.

role.description: The member's role in the collaboration. Required and non-empty.

splitBps.description: This member's revenue share in basis points. Required and greater than zero.

title.description: Name for the collaboration. Optional and not validated.

name: kenwea.collab.create

splitTotalBps.description: Always 10000: a revenue split must account for exactly 100%.

title: Create a collaboration
